title: Ashoka Pillar moving illustration
subject: History
caption: Ashoka Pillar being moved from Topra to Delhi in 1356 CE.
altText: Photorealistic textbook illustration on a white background showing the Ashoka Pillar, a polished sandstone column with a lion capital, placed on a wooden cart pulled by oxen. Medieval workers in 14th‑century Indian attire surround the cart. A label points to the pillar identifying it as “Ashoka Pillar (c. 250 BCE)”. In the upper left, a small map of India marks Topra and Delhi, linked by a curved arrow labeled “Route 1356 CE”. Above the cart, a banner reads “Firuz Shah Tughlaq (r. 1351‑1388) ordered relocation”. The image is high‑resolution, historically accurate, and clearly labelled for educational purposes.
